name: benthic
description: Check reference lists from language models for invented, misattributed and retracted sources, and fetch the real papers through open access, with the Benthic app for macOS.

args: for a in /Applications/Benthic.app "$HOME/Applications/Benthic.app" "$(mdfind "kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier == 'com.isoglu.benthic'" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; do [ -n "$a" ] && [ -x "$a/Contents/Resources/bin/benthic-mcp" ] && exec "$a/Contents/Resources/bin/benthic-mcp"; done; echo "Benthic is not installed. Download it from https://benthic.isoglu.com/download/" >&2; exit 1
